Identify exact population parameters and distinguish them from sample statistics.
A parameter describes every member of a defined population; a statistic describes only a sample.
N: population size. μ: population mean. p: population proportion. σ²: population variance. σ: population standard deviation. Census: complete enumeration.
μ=Σx/N; p=k/N; σ²=Σ(x−μ)²/N; σ=√σ². Population variance uses N, not N−1.
